effects.prompt: Wager an Agility token with the defending hero?

_comment:
'Your next Warrior attack this turn gets +3{p} and "When this attacks a hero, you may wager an Agility token with them." Go again'.

PUMP: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK (handler effect_types.py:4592-4618 reads mod/amount/filter/scope) queues a one-shot on dsl_queued_attack_mods, consumed by engine._apply_turn_attack_effects on the first attack whose card matches the filter; ATTACK_CLASS_IN matches CLASSES AND TALENTS of combat.attack_card via _card_traits (condition_types.py:204-216), so 'Warrior attack' is exact. Non-matching attacks leave the entry queued, so the +3 waits for the next WARRIOR attack rather than burning on any attack.

RIDER VEHICLE: INJECT_TRIGGER scope TURN with the NESTED trigger dict - required so the inner conditions are evaluated per-attack instead of being popped by the loader as an effect-level gate evaluated once at registration (effect_types.py:2103-2119). TURN hooks live on Player.turn_attack_hooks and are re-applied to EVERY attack until end of turn, never consumed after firing (engine.py:1243-1281) - so 'your NEXT Warrior attack' needs a fire-once gate: the NOT FLAG_SET / SET_FLAG pair, the corpus idiom for exactly this sentence family (.drafts/chill_to_the_bone_blue.json, burn_up__shock_red, electrify_blue). Injected triggers fire with card=combat.attack_card (engine.py:1414-1423), so FLAG_SET resolves against the ATTACKER's current_turn_effects - the same player Edge Ahead's controller, since an action played in its own action phase can only ever see that player's attacks this turn.

CONSUMPTION SEMANTICS (deliberate): the flag is set by ANY Warrior attack, because the granted triggered ability rides THAT attack whether or not its condition is met; the wager OFFER is then gated by ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO on the MAY itself (a conditions list there gates whether the prompt is offered at all, effect_types.py:3794-3798). This models release note 2 ('does not trigger if you attack anything other than a hero') under the strict reading that both clauses attach to the one next Warrior attack - an ally-targeting Warrior attack consumes the grant and offers nothing, and does not defer the rider to a later attack. ON_ATTACK not ON_HIT: the text says 'when this attacks', and combat.attack_target is populated before _apply_turn_attack_effects runs (engine.py:534-542), so the hero test is answerable at that timing.

WAGER: handler reads prize/token (effect_types.py:5246) and registers an independent entry on combat.wagers (ability_keywords.add_wager:1039); each resolves separately at chain-link resolution per release note 1 - independence falls out of the list representation. prize 'agility' resolves to json/tokens/agility.json, which EXISTS.

GoAgain is in printed_keywords: it fires from the card DB keywords field and is deliberately NOT authored here (re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect).

KNOWN APPROXIMATION: the flag name is shared across copies, so a second Edge Ahead played the same turn gets no second rider after the first fires - printed text gives each copy its own 'next attack'. Same disclosed limitation as .drafts/burn_up__shock_red.json.
